lpse.title: LPSE agencies
lpse.description: Agency slugs as in https://spse.inaproc.id/<slug>/ (e.g. lkpp, jakarta, jatimprov, pu), or full links. Use * for every agency listed on spse.inaproc.id (about 600).

tahun.title: Fiscal year
tahun.description: Tahun anggaran. Empty = the current year.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search the tender list like the site's search box, e.g. jalan, konsultan, laptop, CCTV. Empty = everything.

tahapan.title: Stage contains
tahapan.description: Keep only tenders whose current stage contains this text, e.g. Pengumuman (still open), Selesai, Evaluasi.

minHps.title: Minimum HPS (Rp)
minHps.description: Skip tenders whose owner estimate (HPS) is below this many rupiah, e.g. 1000000000 for Rp 1 M.

maxHps.title: Maximum HPS (Rp)
maxHps.description: Skip tenders above this many rupiah, e.g. to find work sized for small businesses.

includeDetails.title: Include announcement details
includeDetails.description: Also open each tender's announcement page (location, work unit, funding source, qualification, requirements…). One extra request per tender, so slower.

maxItems.title: Max tenders
maxItems.description: Stop after this many tenders in total (newest first).

maxItemsPerLpse.title: Max tenders per agency
maxItemsPerLpse.description: Optional cap per agency, handy with * so one big agency doesn't use the whole run.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Usually not needed. If the site starts blocking runs, use Apify Proxy with country Indonesia (ID).
